title: LocalUniformHigherDirectImageBound
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and let $s\in S$. There are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ and $n\in\mathbf N$ such that, for every quasi-coherent module $M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $p\ge n$, the restriction of $R^p f_*M$ to $U$ is zero. Here $R^p f_*$ is the ordinary right derived module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image, def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. No quasi-compactness assumption is made on $S$, and $U,n$ are chosen before $M$.

source.place: Tag 01XJ, proof of (3), affine-base finite-cover argument; induction form via Tag 08DR and Tag 01EB

proof.text: Choose an affine open neighbourhood U of s. Let Y=f^{-1}U and g=f|_U:Y→U. Mathlib quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness under target open restriction give CompactSpace Y and QuasiSeparatedSpace Y. Apply quasiCompactOpen_induction to P(W): there is n such that for every quasi-coherent F on Y, every affine open V of U and every p≥n, H^p(W intersect g^{-1}V,F)=0.

For affine W choose n=1. The morphism W→U is affine because both schemes are affine. Hence the inverse image of an affine open V is affine; its image by W.ι is W intersect g^{-1}V, by comp_preimage and image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf. Apply affine-open module cohomology vanishing and convert Subsingleton to IsZero.

For opens A,B with bounds a,b,c for A,B,A intersect B choose max(max(a,b),c)+1. Write p=q+1; arithmetic gives a,b≤p and c≤q. Apply the last exactness position of module_mayerVietoris to A intersect g^{-1}V and B intersect g^{-1}V. The two degree-p terms are zero. Exactness expresses each degree-p union class as the image of a degree-q intersection class, which is zero. Lattice distributivity identifies the resulting union with (A union B) intersect g^{-1}V. This is the proved private helper isZero_openCohomology_union.

Apply the induction conclusion to the compact top open of Y and obtain n. For any quasi-coherent M on X, restriction to Y remains quasi-coherent. Specialize the bound to this restriction, simplify top intersect g^{-1}V, and apply the ordinary restricted higher-direct-image affine-basis criterion degree by degree. U and n were chosen before M.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_uniform_higherDirectImage_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (s : S) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (n : ℕ), s ∈ U ∧
      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), M.IsQuasicoherent →
        ∀ p : ℕ, n ≤ p → IsZero
          (Scheme.Modules.restrict
            (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M)
            U.ι)
